paragraphs: Rabbi Yochanan ben Matya, who told his son that even if he made a meal for his servants [the hired workers in the Mishnah] like Solomon’s, he would not fulfill his obligation. Bava Metzia, the chapter HaSokher Et HaPoalim, mishnah 1, and Gemara 83a.
